utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a repair drive was happening soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — we’re still aiming for the repair drive soon, and I’ll keep it low-key. Once everything’s set, I’ll repeat the plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks—so far I know Cleo’s keeping the running list. If you tell me what’s been gathered, I’ll help keep track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks. I’m just worried about how we’ll sort everything and get it there without missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll double-check the repair drive details first. What’s the first item you want me to look at?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the tool list, please — I can bring a few basics, quietly. What do you want me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Gus — you really mean I can borrow the tools if I need them?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, you can borrow them if you need to. Just let me know what you’re working on, and we’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Sam — thanks for pitching in. We’re gathering tools and sorting the repair list now; I can put you on whichever job needs the most hands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help — put me wherever you need the most hands, and I’ll get to work.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out for where they set up the repair drive and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’d appreciate that. Just let me know where to go when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start, and should I bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of what we still need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I can keep you posted on the start time once I know it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s still on for soon — I’m just waiting on the final time and place details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — just let me know the final time and place, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Quinn — if you need tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow. Just let me know what you’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Gus — thank you! I’ll keep you posted on what we need and swing by with the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It starts at 10, and if you could bring gloves or tape, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll double-check the repair drive details, and I’ll bring gloves or tape. What should I look at first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep an eye out and let you know the exact spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — just let me know where to show up and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks are bringing in all sorts of things. If you need the details, I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Tess—I'd love the details. I’m happy to help spread the word if there’s still room for more donations.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
